changelog:
[B][COLOR ff00fa9a]Version 2.0.17[/COLOR][/B]
[COLOR fffdb515]New: rounded posters[/COLOR]
-Posters and episode pictures have rounded corners in every window luc_kodi draws itself: the context menu and its menus, Sync your devices, the Personal Assistant, Source Results, Uncached Results, the Trakt managers, the next episode dialog and the Up Next and Still Watching cards.
-One rounding for all of them, in proportion to the size of the picture. The selected poster in the Assistant sits on a light rounded frame, and the quality colour around the poster in Source Results follows the same curve.
-The poster wall of Movies and TV shows is drawn by your skin, so it keeps the look of your skin.
[COLOR fffdb515]New: menu windows fit what they show[/COLOR]
-Trakt, MDBList, SIMKL, WeTrakr, PunchPlay and TVmaze Manager, Playlist Manager, Rescrape Options and the lists and ratings they open take only the room they need.
-The height follows the number of options (up to seven at once, longer menus scroll) and the width follows the longest option and the title. The window always stays centred, in 1080 and in 4K.
[COLOR fffdb515]Removed: Bingie UI[/COLOR]
-Bingie UI and Tools > Set Add-on View are retired. Movies and TV shows open in the regular luc_kodi lists, in the poster wall view luc_kodi sets on every skin.
-If you were using Bingie UI, luc_kodi switches to the regular lists by itself after the update, and the views saved for it are deleted once. There is nothing to change in Settings.
-Tools > Viewtypes still lets you save your own view for movies, TV shows, seasons and episodes, and it still comes before the poster wall. Its Menus entry is gone: it was only used by Bingie UI.
-The windows and code of Bingie UI are removed, so the add-on is lighter.
